name: comet-motion
description: From the Damocles title screen, enter the starting world, capture once, wait while the player stands still, then capture again. Both RAM captures carry the Impact Clock at $00793C with its 1/32-second companion at $007942, the comet-path cursor at $00782C with the segment rates at $007822..$00782B, DAMOCLES's centre at $005FB4/$006034, and the whole waypoint table at $052022..$052157, so the comet's centre at each capture can be recomputed from the clock alone and compared with what the machine holds (#440).
